en.title: The Sanctuary of Scrap and the Deceitful Mirror
en.premise: Scavenging for scraps to survive in a rusted city, I stumble upon a "mirror that reflects the past" and an "unaddressed letter." While the blue skies in the mirror offer a glimmer of hope, reality remains harsh: hunger is constant, and ammunition is running low. Yet, as I pursue the "promised land" glimpsed through the glass, the pristine authorities who rule this city begin to bare their fangs.

zh.title: 废品圣域与谎言之镜
zh.premise: 在一座锈迹斑斑的城市里，我靠捡拾废品维生。直到某天，我偶然捡到了一面“映照过去景象的镜子”和一封“无主信件”。即便镜中映出的蓝天令人向往，现实却依旧残酷——饥饿难耐，弹药匮乏。然而，当我执意追寻镜中那片“应许之地”时，统治这座城市的洁癖权贵们，却向我露出了獠牙。
